query.sql:
-- metric orders v3
SELECT
  SUM(orders) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-22' AND DATE '2026-10-22'

comparison.sql:
-- metric orders v3

  SUM(orders) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-15' AND DATE '2026-10-15'
